items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: Because Kent and all them white people didn't mean nothing, so I'm going to live with them in the right way too.

ctx.x: I don't want her to use your name.

She can't hurt me. So you know, like that way, I know my name bill up this much as her name is. You see? So I'm not worried about her. Because she had to be, she had some joy for me, understand? But she never called back. I know she had that, but she had her, but I can't have that. Because otherwise, I'm going to stay with the good people too and live with them right too, understand? Because Kent and all them white people didn't mean nothing, so I'm going to live with them in the right way too. Because sometimes…
Well, what about Kid Rene? You worked with him some, I think you're talking about. Oh yeah, I worked with Rene.
